name: Pixel Art Editor

events.Click:
# Handle this designer button.
pixel_draw(self, event)

props.text: Click or drag to paint. Export PPM or SVG to keep your image.

startup:
# Start with an independent white row for every grid row.
self.pixel_grid = [["#FFFFFF" for column in range(16)] for row in range(16)]
self.pixel_color = "#000000"
pixel_render(self)
self.PixelCanvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", lambda event: pixel_draw(self, event))
self.Form1.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", lambda: pixel_close(self))
self.Form1.deiconify()
